questions.prompt: Explain what makes a deterministic finite state machine deterministic.
hints: Identify the key idea from Finite state machines that the question is testing.
Link each point to why it matters or what effect it has, rather than only naming the term.
questions.solution:
For each state and input symbol there is at most one defined next state. [B1]
The current state plus current input therefore determines the next state uniquely. [B1]
There is no choice between multiple transitions for the same state/input pair. [B1]
